acceptance_condition: Returns at least one finding consisting of a direct quote or close paraphrase from the Smit file, with the exact `===== PDF PAGE N =====` marker(s), that reports performance numbers or rankings on at least two named benchmarks comparing at least one MAD system against a non-debate baseline.
rationale: The acceptance condition requires coverage of performance comparisons on specific benchmarks. The paper includes Table 2 and Figure 3 comparing best performance across seven datasets, and states 'no protocol dominates on all datasets'. Capturing this provides quantitative grounding for the evaluation plan's quality and matched-compute considerations (D14).
text: Extract from papers/text/smit-et-al-2023-going-mad.txt at least one anchored finding that compares performance of MAD systems against single-agent or other prompting baselines on specific benchmarks (e.g., MedQA, PubMedQA, MMLU, CosmosQA, CIAR, GPQA, Chess), quoting or closely paraphrasing the relevant table or sentence and carrying the exact `===== PDF PAGE N =====` marker(s).
